correctionReason: Human review after the accepted v1 familiarity run found the five worlds too geographically abstract: place descriptions described city archetypes but did not authoritatively name a country/region/locality or enough place-specific cultural anchors. v1 remains preserved as accepted-but-insufficient G1 evidence. No G2 genome existed before this correction.

entryPolicy.rule: All five final cohort Threads use the same bornAt and chronology endpoint; life duration may not become an attribution shortcut.

specificityPolicy.encoding: Existing GenesisWorldSpec authority: concrete locality/country facts live in places[].description and culturalContext; no parallel geography authority is introduced.
specificityPolicy.rule: Every current final-cohort World must name an actual country and locality in the WorldSpec and provide enough factual cultural/institutional detail to constrain lived affordances. Concrete geography may not be converted into personality, morality, competence, politics, religion, ethnicity, dignity, willingness or future-profession conclusions.
minimumRequirements: country + locality explicitly named in culturalContext
places[] grounded in that locality rather than generic archetypes
language use situated rather than merely listed
mobility/institutions tied to the actual locality
at least five factual cultural/institutional anchors in culturalContext

freshnessWitness.v1StructureReuse: Household/origin/comparative structure was retained from the burned G1-v1 cohort so the correction changes the missing geographic/cultural specificity rather than opportunistically redesigning expected personalities or H performance.
freshnessWitness.note: Five concrete settings were selected before any cohort genome exists: Cần Thơ (Vietnam), Łódź (Poland), Cusco (Peru), Accra (Ghana), and Greater Sudbury (Ontario, Canada). Factual public sources are recorded in each WorldSpec authorship witness.

convergentPair.broadQuestion: How to respond when formal procedures and observed everyday practice diverge.
convergentPair.constraint: The broad question is protocol-only and must never be passed to Pass A, Pass B, Pass C, record repair, genome generation or cohort publication. The two worlds must remain attributable through different lived routes even if later meanings partially converge.

familiarityPolicy.calls: one stateless call per candidate world
familiarityPolicy.materiallyUnderrepresentedRule: densityScore <= 1 OR at least two coverage-domain scores <= 1
familiarityPolicy.replacementRule: A materially under-represented candidate is preserved as burned G1 candidate evidence and replaced by a newly authored candidate under a new manifest version before any final WorldSpec freeze. No replacement is allowed for aesthetics, personality, narrative quality or expected H performance.
familiarityPolicy.allPassRule: Only if all five candidates are not materially under-represented may the probe tool emit the five v2 final WorldSpec files with non-null familiarityProbe witnesses.
